production_process: The platform is delivered as a cloud-hosted SaaS application. Development follows 2-week sprint cycles using CI/CD pipelines deploying to AWS EU Frankfurt. Each new school onboarding involves LMS integration setup (2-4 weeks), historical data import and model training (1-2 weeks), faculty training and UAT (1 week), go-live and monitoring. Total onboarding time per school is 4-7 weeks depending on LMS complexity.
capacity_plan: Current architecture supports up to 20 schools on single-tenant instances. At 2x (40 schools) migrate to multi-tenant architecture requiring 3-month engineering effort. At 5x (100 schools) require dedicated DevOps hire, upgraded database tier, and CDN for real-time dashboards.
supplier_strategy: AWS as primary cloud provider with EU-West-1 Frankfurt for GDPR compliance. Backup provider GCP for disaster recovery. LMS integration via official partner programmes.
rd_plan: Phase 1 Months 1-4: Core platform and Canvas integration. Phase 2 Months 5-8: Predictive models and Moodle integration. Phase 3 Months 9-12: Benchmarking module and accreditation reporting.

assumptions_used.statement: AWS Frankfurt region satisfies GDPR data residency for all EU schools

assumptions_used.source_detail: Based on comparable SaaS LMS integration timelines

assumptions_used.statement: 800 EUR monthly COGS per school at scale

uncertainties: Whether legacy LMS versions at older schools will require custom integration work
